complexity.notes: `stones.pop() and stones.pop()` is a hacky one-liner that relies on popped weights always being >= 1 (truthy) to execute the second pop; two plain `stones.pop()` calls would be clearer. Re-sorting from scratch each round is wasteful — a max-heap gives O(n log n) total.
complexity.summary: Simulates the smash process by fully re-sorting the list each iteration, popping the two heaviest stones and pushing back the difference when they differ, until at most one stone remains.
